messages:
jess: Heads up — staging canary promo failed during artifact pull. Deploy bot blocked the promotion :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Promotion aborted for release v2026-03-21-abc123. Error: artifact fetch failed (blob digest mismatch). See job staging-canary-42.

rahul: Any logs? did the CI push succeed earlier?

jess: snippet from the canary pod logs:
```
ERR fetch artifact: blob digest mismatch
expected: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe
actual:   sha256:beefdeadbabecafe
registry: eu.registry.redwood-inference/internal
job: ci/artifacts/publish/2026-03-21-17:12
```

linh: That looks like a registry-side corruption or a mirror returning an old blob. Could be GC window + partial reupload. If origin reupload happened, mirrors can be inconsistent.

oliver: CI artifact publish shows green earlier, so most likely registry index vs blob drift. My recommendation: pin canary back to last-good image v2026-03-20-fff111 and hold the promotion until we verify registry integrity.

jess: +1. We should avoid rolling forward users to a potentially corrupted blob. Who can create the rollback PR and notify the release manager?

rahul: I can open the rollback PR now (will reference REL-5123). Also pinging @oncall infra to check registry health.

deploy-bot: Manual action recorded — canary pinned to image v2026-03-20-fff111 by rahul. Automatic rollback initiated for canary route. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Re-running artifact publish job (ci/artifacts/publish) on a new runner to ensure a clean upload. I'll post results here.

sara: Change window note — this blocks the planned promo for 18:00 UTC. Can we hold promo until we confirm either registry fixed or new artifact uploaded? :eyes:

oliver: Yes, hold promo. Update release notes to mention a rollback to previous image and that there's no customer-visible change from this action. I'll prepare a short blurb.

jess: Filed REL-5123 with logs and rollback PR link. CI reupload started. Will update this thread when CI confirms a good publish or infra confirms registry fix. For now, release hold until further notice. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Status update at 1748812600 — canary traffic routed back to v2026-03-20-fff111. Promotion remains blocked.

jess: Thanks all — keeping this channel as the single source of truth for the rollback and unblock plan. If infra finds a root cause, we'll decide whether to re-run promote or schedule a new deployment window.

sara: tagging release checklist owners to update docs and changelog (no user impact).

rahul: CI passed reupload at 1748812689 — artifact checksum matches expected now. I'll wait for infra verification before asking for a re-promote.

linh: infra found a transient mirror sync issue; they kicked a background sync. Recommend waiting 15m post-sync then attempt a canary promote to the new sha.

jess: Ack. Leaving promo on hold until infra confirms stable. Will follow up in 15.
